statement.p: Calculate a Riemann sum S_{3,3} on the square \mathcal{R} = [0,3]\times[0,3] for the function g(x,y)=f(x,y) - 8.
The contour plot of f(x,y) is shown in Figure 4.
Choose sample points and use the plot to find the values of f(x,y) at these points.
Use the values of f(x,y) to evaluate g(x,y) accordingly.

static.solution:

We choose the sample points shown in the figure. The contour plot shows the following values of f at the sample points: \begin{array}{lll} f\left({P}_{11}\right)=2\amp f\left({P}_{21}\right)=3\amp f\left({P}_{31}\right)=4\\ f\left({P}_{12}\right)=3\amp f\left({P}_{22}\right)=4\amp f\left({P}_{32}\right)=7\\ f\left({P}_{13}\right)=5\amp f\left({P}_{23}\right)=6\amp f\left({P}_{33}\right)=10 \end{array} Evaluating g(x,y)=f(x,y) - 8 at these points gives \begin{array}{lll} g\left({P}_{11}\right)=-6\amp g\left({P}_{21}\right)=-5\amp g\left({P}_{31}\right)=-4\\ g\left({P}_{12}\right)=-5\amp g\left({P}_{22}\right)=-4\amp g\left({P}_{32}\right)=-1\\ g\left({P}_{13}\right)=-3\amp g\left({P}_{23}\right)=-2\amp g\left({P}_{33}\right)=2 \end{array} The Riemann sum {S}_{3,3} is thus {S}_{3,3} =\sum_{i=1}^3\sum_{j=1}^3g\left({P}_{ij}\right)\Delta A =\sum_{i=1}^3\sum_{j=1}^3g\left({P}_{ij}\right)\cdot 1 =-6 - 5 - 4 - 5 - 4 - 1 - 3 - 2+2 =-28
